report.rationale: The incident report of a confirmed embolic stroke temporally linked to an unflagged rapid-ventricular-response atrial fibrillation episode is a serious patient safety risk that requires immediate action under EU MDR Article 87(1)-(2) and Article 10(12). The severity-scoring submodule changes (ARTIFACT-DIFF-0009) may have contributed to the missed detection, as flagged by static analysis (ARTIFACT-STATICANALYSIS-0003), which requires Class II revalidation. This incident also triggers obligations under EU MDR Article 88(1) for trend reporting.
